verdict.rationale: The MI355X's own vendor software stack, ROCm, is documented as open source, so users can read the compilers, runtimes and libraries that drive the accelerator. The hardware itself (silicon design, firmware) is not shown as open, and the docs name no specific license or source repository. Missing for 10: named open license terms, links to source repositories, any evidence on firmware or hardware openness, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: ROCm is AMD’s open-source GPU computing platform: an end‑to‑end ecosystem of compilers, runtimes, and libraries for AI, HPC, and domain‑specific workloads.
It is open source, cross‑platform (Linux and Windows), and optimized for AMD Instinct™, AMD Radeon™, and AMD Ryzen™ AI devices.
Open-source collections of ROCm-accelerated libraries for building high-performance domain-specific applications.
